$comment: Model routing reference. Prefer subscription models over API-billed. Fallback chain: Gemini (sub) → Codex (sub) → OpenAI API → Sonnet (API) → Opus (API) → Ollama (local).

main_chat.rationale: Fast, cheap, good for general conversation. Subscription via google-gemini-cli OAuth.

coding.rationale: Strong coding on subscription. Use /model gpt-5.4 in Coding topic.

deep_research.rationale: Strong reasoning on subscription via Codex OAuth.

crons_lightweight.rationale: Lightweight checks. No need for frontier models.

crons_heavy.rationale: Memory synthesis and doc drift on subscription.

precision.rationale: Best-in-class reasoning (91% GPQA Diamond). API-billed — use only when Codex falls short.

local_fallback.rationale: Gemma 4 26B MoE: 3.8B active params for fast inference, 256K context. Free, local Metal GPU. No web tools allowed.
